title: CubeSat
summary: 1U to 6U to the CDS, stowed or deployed
description: A CubeSat structure and layout to the CubeSat Design Specification: the form factor, the payload, the PC/104 stack, the battery, the radio and the solar wings. Drag it from stowed in the dispenser to deployed in orbit, and the form keeps it inside the CDS envelope, mass and centre-of-gravity limits.
process: CNC milling and hard anodising of the rails and frames; PCB outlines for the solar panels

difficulty.rationale: A closed-form mass and centre-of-gravity budget of every part through a rotating drive, form ranges derived from it, and fastener, hinge and CDS process checks across about 40 bodies.

standards: CubeSat Design Specification Rev. 14.1 (CP-CDS-R14.1, Cal Poly SLO, 2022), read: 2.2.1 to 2.2.14 (envelope, protrusions, rail width, roughness, edge radius, standoff contact, mass Table 1, centre of gravity Table 2, aluminium, hard anodise, separation springs), 2.3.2 and 2.3.5 (deployment switches, RBF pin), 2.4.4, Figure 5 and the Appendix B drawings CDS-14-001 to 008

PC/104 Specification Version 2.4 (PC/104 Embedded Consortium, 2001), read: section 2, Figure 1 and the module drawings of Appendix A: 3.550 x 3.775 in, holes 0.125 in at (0.200, 0.200), (3.350, 0.200), (0.350, 3.575), (3.250, 3.575) in, 0.6 in stack pitch, 1.6 mm board, 0.435 in component height, J1/J2 pin rows
ISO 7046-1:2011 Table 1 (read, iTeh preview): M2 countersunk head dk theoretical 4.4 mm, actual 3.8 max, k 1.2 max; head gauging per ISO 7721 (not read)
ISO 7045:2011 Table 1 (read, iTeh preview): M2 pan head dk 4.0 max, k 1.60 max
AZUR SPACE 3G30-Advanced (4x8) datasheet DB 00010891-01 (2025): CIC 40.15 x 80.15 mm, 290 um, 3.6 g, 2411 mV and 499 mA at maximum power, BOL AM0
Panasonic NCR18650B datasheet (version 13.11 R1): 18.5 x 65.3 mm max, 48.5 g max, 3200 mAh rated, 3.6 V
Densities: 6082-T6 2.70 g/cm3 (Smiths Advanced Metals 6082 bar datasheet), FR4 1.85 (Ryertex Grade FR4), stainless 304 8.00 (Smiths Advanced Metals 304 sheet datasheet)
Builder's judgement, not from a source: 70 g per populated PC/104 board, 60 g battery board, 90 g antenna module, the frame and rail design, cell margins, the deployment sequence
materials: Aluminium 6082-T6 bar and 11 mm plate, CNC milled, hard anodised black (rails and end frames)
FR4 1.6 mm (body panels, wings), triple-junction solar cells with coverglass, gold Kapton on the wing backs

Stainless steel 304 (stack rods M3, hinge pins, plungers); M2 screws: ISO 7046-1 countersunk (rails, hinge brackets, antenna module) and ISO 7045 pan head (body and +Z panels); spring plungers and microswitches bought
PC/104 boards, 18650 battery, antenna module and payload: bought or designed separately
